title: Share of upper-secondary students in vocational programmes (UIS)
description: Students enrolled in vocational programmes at upper-secondary level (ISCED 3) as a percentage of all upper-secondary students, both sexes.
comparability: For EU, EFTA and OECD countries these figures come from the same joint UNESCO-OECD-Eurostat (UOE) collection as Eurostat's education statistics; UIS adds candidate countries. 'Vocational' includes school-based as well as work-based (apprenticeship-type) programmes, so this measures the weight of VET, not of apprenticeship.

provenance.citation: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), indicator GTVP.3.V, https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/, data version 20260507-91260335.
